zhs.pages.INITIAL.description:
石阶忽然尽了。眼前是一望无际的绿草与过分干净的蓝天。白房子沿着大路两侧，整齐地排到视线之外。

你走了一会儿，又看见同一只蓝色邮筒。天上的云连边缘都没有变。

里面有封信，纸上是你的笔迹：
[gold]「欢迎回来。房子已经替你留好了。」[/gold]
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE.title: 合并两扇门
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE.description: 合并[blue]2[/blue]张同名、未升级且未附魔的牌，留下[green]1[/green]张升级版。
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE_LOCKED.title: 已锁定
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE_LOCKED.descr: 需要两张同名、可升级且可移除的未升级、未附魔牌。
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS.title: 给自己留一间
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS.descriptio: 失去[red]{AddressMaxHpLoss}[/red]最大生命。升级[blue]1[/blue]张牌并赋予[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]。
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS_LOCKED.des: 需要一张可升级、可获得[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]的牌。
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.ROAD.title: 走到天黑为止
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.ROAD.description: 失去[red]{RoadHpLoss}[/red]生命，获得[gold]{Gold}[/gold]金币。可继续绕行。
zhs.pages.INITIAL.options.BLUE.title: 从蓝屋的后门走
zhs.roadHint.title: 没有尽头的路
zhs.roadHint.description: 每圈的生命代价与金币翻倍。最多[blue]{MaximumLaps}[/blue]圈，每圈后均可离开。
zhs.pages.MERGE.keepPrompt: 选择要留下并升级的牌。
zhs.pages.MERGE.foldPrompt: 选择另一张同名牌，将其合并掉。
zhs.pages.MERGE.description:
你抓住两只一模一样的门把，把它们拉到一起。

两栋房子像纸页般合拢。没有倒塌声，只有清脆的[gold]咔哒[/gold]。

牌组薄了一点。留下的那张却更有分量。你往远处望去，怎么也数不清少了哪一栋。
zhs.pages.ADDRESS.selectionPrompt: 选择一张牌，升级并赋予完美契合。
zhs.pages.ADDRESS.description:
你在空白门牌上写下自己的名字。笔尖越走越慢，仿佛正从你身上蘸取墨水。

屋里传来椅子被拉开的声音。有人替你坐下了。

你洗了洗手里的牌。那张牌又回到最上面。像是终于有了一个[gold]认得路的地方[/gold]。
zhs.pages.LAP_1.description:
你一直走，一直走。太阳分毫未动。

蓝色邮筒又出现在路边，里面躺着一封给你的信，信封里全是金币。

[gold]「辛苦了。下次请走远一点。」[/gold]

字迹还是你的。
zhs.pages.LAP_2.description:
房屋、草坪、云朵，再次严丝合缝地排回原位。只有你的腿更疼了。

信封更厚。

这次的信很短：[gold]「再走一圈，就该到家了。」[/gold]
zhs.pages.ROAD.options.CONTINUE.title: 再走一圈（第{NextLap}圈）
zhs.pages.ROAD.options.STOP.title: 够远了
zhs.pages.ROAD.options.STOP.description: 保留已获得的金币，离开。
zhs.pages.ROAD_STOP.description:
你把信封塞进口袋，朝蓝屋走去。

身后传来邮筒盖轻轻合上的声音。

你没有回头。有些钱，不必挣完。
zhs.pages.ROAD_END.description:
第三次，邮筒里只剩最后一个信封。

你抬头，看见远处有个身影正沿着路走来。它拎着你的包。

你带上金币，立刻从蓝屋的后门离开。天空依然很蓝。你已经看够了。
zhs.pages.BLUE.description:
蓝屋的门后放着一只碟子，里面是替你留好的[gold]零钱[/gold]。

你收好金币，穿过后门。洞穴里的水滴声又回来了。
zhs.pages.ABORTED.description:
你停下手。门牌又变回空白，房子依次退回原位。

蓝屋的后门还开着。你决定暂时没有地址，也很好。
zhs.pages.DEATH.description:
你终于不用再走了。

天边，多了一栋白房子。

eng.pages.INITIAL.description:
The steps simply end. Grass stretches beneath an impossibly clean blue sky. Identical white houses line both sides of a road that runs beyond sight.

After a while, you pass the same blue mailbox. Not even the edges of the clouds have moved.

Inside is a letter in your handwriting:
[gold]“Welcome back. We kept a house for you.”[/gold]
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE.title: Bring Two Doors Together
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE.description: Merge [blue]2[/blue] unupgraded, unenchanted copies into [green]1[/green] upgraded card.
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE_LOCKED.title: Locked
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.MERGE_LOCKED.descr: Requires two matching, removable, unupgraded, unenchanted cards that can be upgraded.
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS.title: Keep a Room for Yourself
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS.descriptio: Lose [red]{AddressMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card and Enchant it with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.ADDRESS_LOCKED.des: Requires an upgradable card that can receive [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.ROAD.title: Walk Until Sundown
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.ROAD.description: Lose [red]{RoadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. You may keep walking.
eng.pages.INITIAL.options.BLUE.title: Take the Blue House's Back Door
eng.roadHint.title: The Road Without End
eng.roadHint.description: The HP cost and Gold double each lap. Walk up to [blue]{MaximumLaps}[/blue] laps. You may leave after any lap.
eng.pages.MERGE.keepPrompt: Choose the card to keep and upgrade.
eng.pages.MERGE.foldPrompt: Choose a matching card to fold away.
eng.pages.MERGE.description:
You take two identical door handles and pull them together.

The houses close like pages. No crash. Just a crisp [gold]click[/gold].

Your deck is thinner. The remaining card feels heavier. Looking down the road, you cannot tell which house is missing.
eng.pages.ADDRESS.selectionPrompt: Choose a card to upgrade and Enchant with Perfect Fit.
eng.pages.ADDRESS.description:
You write your name on the blank plaque. The pen slows, as though drawing its ink from somewhere inside you.

A chair scrapes against the floor. Someone has sat down for you.

You shuffle your cards. That one returns to the top. At last, it [gold]knows its way home[/gold].
eng.pages.LAP_1.description:
You walk and walk. The sun does not move.

The blue mailbox returns. Inside is another letter addressed to you, its envelope full of coins.

[gold]“Well done. A little farther next time.”[/gold]

Still your handwriting.
eng.pages.LAP_2.description:
The houses, lawns, and clouds fall perfectly back into place. Only your legs have changed. They hurt more.

The envelope is thicker.

This letter is short: [gold]“One more lap. Then you'll be home.”[/gold]
eng.pages.ROAD.options.CONTINUE.title: Another Lap ({NextLap})
eng.pages.ROAD.options.STOP.title: Far Enough
eng.pages.ROAD_STOP.description:
You pocket the envelope and head for the blue house.

Behind you, the mailbox clicks shut.

You do not turn around. Some money can stay unearned.
eng.pages.ROAD_END.description:
On the third lap, only one envelope remains.

A figure is approaching along the distant road. It carries your pack.

You take the coins and hurry through the blue house's back door. The sky is still blue. You have seen enough of it.
eng.pages.BLUE.description:
A little dish waits behind the blue door, holding [gold]change[/gold] set aside for you.

You pocket it and take the back door. The cave resumes dripping.
eng.pages.ABORTED.description:
You stop. The plaque goes blank, and the houses slide back into place.

The blue house's back door is still open. For now, having no address will do.
eng.pages.DEATH.description:
At last, you no longer have to walk.

Another white house appears on the horizon.
